name: Shortwave
shortDescription: Email AI at $30 per seat per month, with a 14-day free trial.
longDescription: Shortwave offers Everyday AI productivity at $30 per seat per month and a 14-day free trial, with higher seat prices above that. It includes AI search and filters.
pricingNotes: Everyday AI productivity is $30 per seat per month, with a 14-day free trial.
bestFor: Searching an inbox and drafting from an AI email client
notIdealFor: A team that wants a one-time price instead of per seat
strength: Shortwave lists Everyday AI productivity at $30 per seat per month and a 14-day free trial.
weakness: The price is per seat, and higher tiers on the same page cost $45 and $120 per seat.

useCaseFit.manage-inbox: AI email client at $30 per seat per month with a 14-day trial.
